what: HIGH (code audit CA-A01-053, MEASURED): On a netted Alpaca symbol with >=2 open journal rows, the equity naked sweep re-arms only the FIRST row's qty and then treats the symbol as protected, because the re-arm gate is AlpacaClient.protection_state (any stop leg of any side and qty) — so the sweep itself converts 'fully naked' into a permanent partial that is paged but never repaired. LOCATION: src/runtime/order_monitor.py:L8179-L8314. PROPOSED FIX: Gate the re-arm on the quantity grade already computed (stop_qty + eps < size) and re-arm the uncovered qty once per symbol (one OCO for size - stop_qty), not per-row protection_state; place_protective's symbol-wide pre-cancel must then be scoped or the OCO sized to the whole position.
